name: Vineyard Landscape of Piedmont: Langhe-Roero and Monferrato
description: In southern Piedmont, between the Po River and the Ligurian Apennines, rows of vines ripple across the hills of the Langhe, Roero and Monferrato. Five wine-growing areas and the Castle of Cavour make up the site. Grapes have grown here since at least the 5th century BC, and local dialect still carries Etruscan and Celtic wine words.
